name: Nonlinear stimulus representations in neural circuits with approximate excitatory-inhibitory balance
venue: PLoS computational biology, vol. 16, no. 9, e1008192, 2020
description: This paper demonstrates how even simple biophysical plasticity rules can give rise to complex nonlinear computations in networks of spiking neurons operating within a semi-balanced regime. Trained a realistic spiking neural network in an unsupervised manner to perform image classification on the MNIST dataset.
